notes.title: Zeta 1.02 Update
notes.content:
Some updates to Station Zeta to improve overall player experience.

General
--------------------------------
* Adjustments to Player hitbox for more generous collision detection.
* Adjustments to many enemy hitboxes for more generous collision detection.
* Added "Out of Ammo" sound when firing an empty blaster
* Adjusted level geometry of Hard Hat Area for better flow.
* Adjusted enemy positions in several levels
* Adjusted level geometry of Bullseye to reduce stuck ammo scenarios

Bug Fixes
-------------------------
* Input improvements to reduce dropped velocity.
* Removed situations in which an ascending platform would count as a crush death.
* Removed situation in which a stationary box would trigger a crush death.
